name: 38125 · Memphis, TN
findings: ZIP 38125 (Memphis) has 215 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38125 (Memphis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
